## Discussion

This command causes the lock device to unlock the door without pulling the latch.

## Declaration

```objectivec
- (void) unboltDoorWithParams:(MTRDoorLockClusterUnboltDoorParams *) params completion:(MTRStatusCompletion) completion;
```

<a id="discussion"></a>

## Discussion

This command causes the lock device to unlock the door without pulling the latch.



<a id="discussion"></a>

## Discussion

This command MAY be used by a client to obtain a correlated view of both System Time, and, if currently synchronized and supported, “wall clock time” of the server.
